findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?tools=core" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: margin_faceoff_status, margin_test_move, margin_fit_check, margin_replay_dataset · Private data: margin_delegate_key, margin_fit_check, margin_replay_dataset · Public sink: margin_faceoff_status · Destructive: margin_jobs, margin_faceoff_status, margin_test_move, margin_test_model, margin_fit_check, margin_replay_dataset.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: margin_faceoff_status, margin_test_move, margin_fit_check, margin_replay_dataset · Private data: margin_delegate_key, margin_fit_check, margin_replay_dataset · Public sink: margin_faceoff_status · Destructive: margin_jobs, margin_faceoff_status, margin_test_move, margin_test_model, margin_fit_check, margin_replay_dataset

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
